scope: Read-only final readback of the six physically materialized Drafts against the final manifest and candidate bodies. PASS is limited to Draft creation and exact source fidelity; engine admission remains explicitly blocked.

candidate_packet.note: The whole-file SHA changed only because final preflight results were recorded; each reviewed candidate body matches its materialized Draft.

checks.name: manifest_and_exact_body_readback
checks.evidence: All six actual file hashes match the manifest. Their frontmatter status, marker, version, role, form, tier, active-only Subject, and relations match the packet. Every post-frontmatter body byte matches its reviewed candidate body with only the expected Markdown boundary newline.

checks.name: source_pins_and_semantics
checks.evidence: All four pinned Current source hashes remain unchanged. The four new Declarations retain eight recognized CFEL constraints: mandatory zero-value containers, exactly File then Name and Path, and one string direct value with zero children on each leaf. The proposal's links and adoption boundary match the reviewed packet.

checks.name: engine_admission_boundary
checks.evidence: engine-preflight records six failures before candidate evaluation with the common cause Current frontmatter encoding authority is unreviewed. The manifest correctly records manual identity/destination-only Draft preparation under the shared identity lock; it makes no promotion, admission, runtime, Current, or Journal claim.

admission_limit: Engine admission is BLOCKED until the separate Current frontmatter encoding authority issue is reviewed. This gate neither requests nor performs an engine repair.
